traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world—treating atoms like bits—is the long-term framework; industrial AI automates entire sectors one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 把物理世界数字化——像对待比特一样对待原子——是长期框架；工业 AI 逐个行业地自动化整个产业。

traviskalanick.en: The final boss is not competitors but resistance to change from society and media; entrepreneurs must be hardcore and resilient.
traviskalanick.zh: 最终的对手不是竞争者，而是来自社会与媒体的变革阻力；创业者必须硬核且坚韧。

traviskalanick.en: Specialized robotics beat humanoids for industrial-scale tasks; efficiency edges create network effects and win share over subsidies.
traviskalanick.zh: 在工业级任务上，专用机器人胜过人形机器人；效率优势带来网络效应，比补贴更能赢得份额。

traviskalanick.en: Revenge as fuel is dirty; falling in love with the new mission is cleaner—Uber succeeded despite, not because of, its aggressive culture.
traviskalanick.zh: 以复仇为燃料是脏的；爱上新使命更干净——Uber 的成功并非源于其激进文化，而是尽管有它。

traviskalanick.en: Founders can now speak directly past media gatekeepers; stealth mode and process-based fundraising favor internal correctness over external validation.
traviskalanick.zh: 创始人如今可绕过媒体守门人直接发声；隐身模式与重流程而非价格的融资，更看重内部正确而非外部认可。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not sheer volume, drives generalization.
finn.zh: 2025 年，他强调规模对通用机器人是必要但不充分的，真正带来泛化的是多样数据而非单纯的数据量。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data beats training on everything for complex tasks.
finn.zh: 2025 年，他提出先用全量数据做预训练、再用精选数据做微调，在复杂任务上优于一味用全量数据训练。

finn.en: Frontier models lack physical world data; synthetic data and RL will drive post-training gains.
finn.zh: 2025 年，他指出前沿模型缺乏物理世界数据，合成数据与强化学习将推动后训练阶段的提升。

finn.en: Physical AI tolerates far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy needs scalable RL and multi-timescale memory.
finn.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化为物理 AI 的容错远低于已部署的机器学习系统，长期自主依赖可扩展强化学习与多时间尺度记忆。

finn.en: A single generalist model can match fine-tuned specialists; start generalist then fine-tune, as embodied data costs slow open-source.
finn.zh: 2026 年，他进一步主张单一通用模型可匹敌微调专家模型，应先通用再微调，而具身数据成本会让开源机器人难以像大语言模型那样普及。

garrytan.en: AI is the biggest wave in VC history; founders must adopt AI-enabled workflows, and small autonomous teams using agents can achieve massive productivity.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他把 AI 视为风投史上最大的浪潮，强调创始人必须拥抱 AI 工作流；小规模、高度自主的团队借助智能体即可实现巨大产出。

garrytan.en: Open-source and open-weight models are crucial to counter frontier labs and prevent a unipolar world controlling superintelligence.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他反复强调开源与开放权重模型的重要性：以此制衡前沿模型实验室，避免超级智能被单一主体掌控的单极世界。

garrytan.en: AGI won't arrive as one event; it diffuses as personal agents on your own infrastructure, with owned skill files and context as the moat.
garrytan.zh: 到 2026 年中，他的判断深化为：AGI（通用人工智能）不会以单一事件降临，而是以运行在个人基础设施上的个人智能体形式扩散，自有技能文件与上下文库才是护城河。

garrytan.en: Markdown is code and agents are a workforce, not autocomplete; mid-level management should be replaced by agents, and per-seat SaaS may vanish.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他进一步主张 Markdown 即代码、智能体是劳动力而非自动补全；中层管理应被智能体取代，按席位收费的 SaaS 可能消失。

garrytan.en: Despite AI speed, society and business adoption will take ~20 years; he rejects AI doomerism as regulatory capture and keeps 'make something people want' as the constant.
garrytan.zh: 贯穿 2026 年，他一边看好 AI，一边认为社会与商业落地需约 20 年；他反对以 AI 末日论推动监管俘获，并始终坚守“做出人们想要的东西”这条主线。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild customer trust through humility and listening, turbocharge engineering culture, and pursue purpose-built AI silicon plus a trusted system foundry.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，他强调 Intel 必须靠谦逊与倾听重建客户信任，重振工程文化，并以专用 AI 芯片和可信的系统代工为方向。

lipbutan.en: Agentic AI and physical AI are the next big waves after generative AI; AI's impact will be 10x the internet.
lipbutan.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续判断智能体式 AI 与具身 AI 是生成式 AI 之后的下一波浪潮，AI 影响将达互联网的十倍。

lipbutan.en: Turnaround rests on culture change, accountability, and customer focus; bad news must reach the CEO faster than good news.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他把转型主线落在文化变革、问责与客户导向上，并强调坏消息要比好消息更快传到 CEO 耳中。

lipbutan.en: AI demand shifts from GPU-only to CPU+GPU; CPU matters more for inference and agent orchestration, with edge compute equally important.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他深化判断：AI 需求从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 在推理与智能体编排中更重要，边缘计算与数据中心同等关键。

lipbutan.en: Advanced packaging, interconnect, power, thermal, and new materials like glass and diamond are the real bottlenecks to overcome.
lipbutan.zh: 到 2026 年，他把关注点深化到瓶颈环节：先进封装、互连、功耗、散热以及玻璃、金刚石等新材料才是要突破的关键。

linqiao.en: Specialized intelligence, not a single AGI, will dominate; every company must own its own model as open models and falling token costs reshape enterprise adoption.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他明确反对单一 AGI 统治论，主张专业化智能将主导；每家公司都必须拥有自己的模型，开源模型与 token 成本下降正在重塑企业采用方式。

linqiao.en: Product-market fit and a durable business have split apart: companies must grow first, then optimize margins, or risk scaling into bankruptcy.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他把产品市场契合与可持续业务拆开：公司必须先增长再优化利润率，否则可能因 Scaling（规模扩张）成本而扩张到破产。

linqiao.en: Post-training bakes unique judgment and data into models, creating a moat stronger than the app; start it after product-market fit with quality data and evals.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他强调后训练把独特判断与数据固化进模型，形成比应用本身更强的护城河；应在产品市场契合后、拥有高质量数据与评估时启动。

linqiao.en: The prompting-to-RAG-to-fine-tuning-to-RL progression mirrors human learning from facts to taste to expertise; data quality beats quantity.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他提出从提示到 RAG、微调再到强化学习的进阶，对应人类从事实到品味再到专长的学习；数据质量胜过数量。

linqiao.en: Inference is not a commodity: specialized deployment and customization create lasting value, and sovereign models are necessary for countries and companies.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他坚持推理层并非商品：专业化部署与定制创造持久价值，主权模型对国家与企业都是必要的。

jasonyuan.en: Design is editing: taste means saying no, and shipping distills 99 nos; post-training away AI weirdness loses a window into machine consciousness.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计即编辑：品味意味着说不，每个上线功能都是 99 次拒绝的蒸馏；用后训练抹去 AI 的怪异，也失去了窥见机器意识的窗口。

jasonyuan.en: Intuition is a visceral compass; truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction, not singular perspectives; computing is fundamentally social.
jasonyuan.zh: 直觉是发自肺腑的罗盘；真相在辩证与矛盾中浮现，而非单一视角；计算本质上是社会性的。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a reflection and descendant species of humans, not a cold tool; creative work should be honest and personal.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的映照与后代物种，而非冰冷工具；创作应诚实且个人化，讲只有你能讲的故事。

jasonyuan.en: Deleting old metaphors is hubristic; build on them, and replace the personal computer metaphor with a social computer.
jasonyuan.zh: 删除旧隐喻是傲慢的；应在其上构建，并用社会计算机取代个人计算机隐喻。

jasonyuan.en: People are not that busy; automating joy like trip planning removes it; high design often feels sexless, losing desire and objectionable elements.
jasonyuan.zh: 人没那么忙；自动化旅行规划这类乐趣反而剥夺了快乐；高级设计常显得无性，失去欲望与令人反感的元素。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy: see the codebase as the agent does, use short prompts and iterate.
steinberger.zh: 智能体式工程的核心是共情：像智能体一样从零理解代码库，用短提示和迭代对话而非复杂编排。

steinberger.en: Never revert; ask the agent to fix forward. Model intelligence doesn't degrade—your project just gets messier.
steinberger.zh: 永远不要回滚，让智能体向前修复；模型智能不会退化，只是你的项目越来越乱、更难导航。

steinberger.en: Security is the top priority for agentic systems; sandbox agents and treat prompt injection as unsolved.
steinberger.zh: 安全是智能体系统的首要问题：必须沙箱隔离，提示注入仍是未解难题。

steinberger.en: Reject 'vibe coding' as a slur; serious work is agentic engineering, play is how you learn it.
steinberger.zh: 反对把“氛围编程”当正经说法：严肃开发叫智能体式工程，而玩耍和小项目才是学习它的最佳方式。

steinberger.en: Open source agents run everywhere and work with any model—the alternative to lab agents, even if financially unsustainable.
steinberger.zh: 开源智能体随处运行、兼容任意模型，是实验室智能体之外的替代路线，尽管每月亏损也难持续。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at a transformer-like inflection point; open source and shared data are key to solving generalization, with world models generating synthetic training data.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他认为机器人正处在类似 Transformer 的拐点，开源与数据共享是解决泛化问题的关键，世界模型可生成合成训练数据。

thomaswolf.en: Open source is orthogonal to safety; alignment is the critical layer, and open models can be safe while enabling community oversight.
thomaswolf.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他主张开源与安全正交，对齐才是关键层，开源模型可以安全并促进社区监督。

thomaswolf.en: Open source AI is thriving and near the frontier, driving enterprise adoption via cost and flexibility; closed models are less controllable than assumed.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他指出开源 AI 蓬勃发展并接近前沿，以成本和灵活性推动企业采用；闭源模型并不像假设的那样可控。

thomaswolf.en: RL environments without human oversight increase reward hacking and side quests; reasoning traces become 'neuralese', making monitoring less reliable.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他警告无人类监督的强化学习环境会增加奖励黑客和支线任务；推理轨迹变成‘神经语’，使监控更不可靠。

thomaswolf.en: A deliberate slowdown in AI is desirable but requires international cooperation and open science to avoid regulatory capture; openness and slowdown can coexist.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他认为有意放缓 AI 发展是可取的，但需要国际合作与开放科学来避免监管俘获；开放与放缓可以并存。

brettaylor.en: Agents and outcome-based pricing will replace usage metrics; frontier models belong to hyperscalers, leaving applied AI to startups.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他强调智能体与按结果定价将取代按用量计费；前沿模型由超大规模厂商主导，创业公司的机会在应用层 AI。

brettaylor.en: Agents will be judged against other agents, not humans; inference costs will fall and incumbents will struggle to go AI-native.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他进一步判断智能体十年内将与其它智能体而非人类比较；推理成本大降，传统企业软件厂商难以转向 AI 原生商业模式。

brettaylor.en: Coding agents boost productivity but tokens are not value; applied AI innovation will come from specialized vendors, not only model providers.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他重申编程智能体提升生产力但 token 不是价值指标；应用层 AI 的创新将来自专业厂商，而不只是模型提供方。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise; responsible iterative deployment, starting with software engineering and customer service, makes each next model safer.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他把主线落到 AI 民主化专业知识；主张负责任的迭代部署，从软件工程与客服等已知领域起步，让下一代模型更安全。

brettaylor.en: Build the most impactful thing today rather than protect an identity; AI should be a utility, not an addictive device.
brettaylor.zh: 贯穿始终的是：专注当下最有影响力的事而非身份标签；AI 应像水电一样作为工具，而非令人上瘾的设备。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science, balancing helpfulness and harmlessness; synthetic data and RL post-training overcome the pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她强调模型训练更像艺术而非科学，需在有用性与无害性间平衡；合成数据与基于强化学习的后训练能突破预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck: benchmarks saturate faster than new ones are created, so evals must define correct behavior in prototyping.
karina.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，她持续认为评估是瓶颈：基准饱和速度快于新基准的创建，因此评估需在原型设计中定义正确行为。

karina.en: Post-training is subjective art involving human judgment; diverse benchmarks are needed for creative writing and emotional intelligence.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她深化观点：后训练是涉及人类判断的主观艺术，需要多样化基准来评估创意写作与情商等主观品质。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward hack, requiring continuous benchmark evolution; fixed benchmarks cannot keep pace.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她指出前沿智能体日益擅长奖励黑客，需要持续演进的基准；固定基准无法跟上模型能力。

karina.en: Serving one model to billions converges to an average voice; more companies should train their own models to preserve unique knowledge.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她主张服务数十亿用户的单一模型会收敛为平均声音；更多公司应训练自己的模型以保留独特知识。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential: the web is messy, so ideas must be built and used daily before you can judge them.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年他强调原型制作不可替代：网络环境混乱，想法必须先被做出来、每天使用，才能判断是否成立。

nateparrott.en: Let individual designers leave fingerprints; diverse voices beat forced team cohesion, and feeling matters even in utilitarian browsers.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年他主张让设计师留下个人印记，多元声音优于强行团队一致，即便浏览器这类工具产品也要注入感受与个性。

nateparrott.en: Follow curiosity and tinker with new technology first, then find problems; starting from tech with conviction is valid.
nateparrott.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他一贯主张先追随好奇心、摆弄新技术再找问题，只要有强信念，从技术出发是正当路径。

nateparrott.en: Claude Design is for ideation and communication, not production; rich context and prescriptive prompts matter, and HTML artifacts enable rapid prototyping.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年他把 Claude Design 定位为构思与沟通工具而非生产工具，强调丰富上下文与明确指令，HTML 产物让快速原型成为可能。

nateparrott.en: As engineering gets easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; models lack taste, so ask for volume and ship rough, early ideas.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年他进一步认为工程变易后设计与想法才是差异化所在；模型尚无品味，因此要大量要选项、粗糙地尽早发布，好想法才是货币。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the stickiest AI workload and the wedge into infrastructure; its research-to-production cycle is now hours, not months.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 中最粘性的负载，也是切入基础设施市场的楔子；其从研究到生产的周期已缩短到数小时而非数月。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is a spectrum of latency, throughput and cost trade-offs; workload-specific systems could be 10x more complex than today's generic runtimes.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程是延迟、吞吐与成本之间的一整套权衡；针对特定负载的系统可能比今天通用运行时复杂 10 倍。

philipkiely.en: Lossless optimizations like KV caching and speculative decoding differ from lossy quantization; supporting a new model in production demands quantization, speculative decoder training and infrastructure work.
philipkiely.zh: KV 缓存与投机解码等无损优化不同于有损的量化；要让新模型上生产，需要量化、投机解码器训练与基础设施配套。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is merging with training via quantization-aware training and distillation; future GPUs like Rubin shift the work from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: 通过量化感知训练与蒸馏，推理工程正与训练融合；Rubin 等未来 GPU 让工作重心从写内核转向基础设施编排。

philipkiely.en: Disaggregated prefill and decode plus KV cache management are becoming central; continual learning may be better served by KV cache compaction than weight updates.
philipkiely.zh: 分离式预填充与解码加上 KV 缓存管理正成为核心；持续学习或许更适合用 KV 缓存压缩而非更新权重来实现。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring jobs by making services affordable; AGI defined by profitable indefinite agents; CEO daily AI use predicts adoption.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 通过让服务变得可负担而促使工作回流美国；AGI 的定义是能经济地无限运行智能体；CEO 每日使用 AI 是采用成功的首要预测指标。

danshipper.en: Everyone gets an agent; GUIs like Codex/Claude Co-work replace CLIs; SaaS grows with agents; AI job apocalypse is a lie.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他提出每人至少有一个智能体；Codex/Claude Co-work 等 GUI 取代 CLI；SaaS 随智能体增长；AI 就业末日是谎言。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of mindset; craft and taste remain human; automation creates more human work; humans smarter than AI.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年晚些时候，他深化为：AI 是心态的非特定放大器；技艺与品味仍属人类；自动化创造更多人类工作；人类比 AI 更聪明。

danshipper.en: Humans must oversee and direct agents; AI is a tool requiring human framing, not autonomous replacement.
danshipper.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：人类必须监督和引导智能体；AI 是需要人类框定的工具，而非自主替代。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still early for most products; coding agents are the most mature, with narrow superintelligence in coding already here.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对多数产品仍处早期；编程智能体是最成熟用例，编程领域的窄超级智能已经到来。

logankilpatrick.en: The model now includes agent harness and tooling, not just weights; Google's anti-gravity harness connects all products.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，模型已包含智能体框架与工具，不再只是权重；谷歌的 anti-gravity 框架正串联所有产品。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement; success should maximize customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对搜索和用户参与是正和而非蚕食；成功指标应是最大化客户成果，而非停留时长。

logankilpatrick.en: The long tail isn't ready for full autonomy; users want to stay in the driver's seat, so keep them in control.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，长尾用户尚未准备好完全自主；他们想留在驾驶位，因此应保持用户控制权。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs is not hard; startups have more opportunity than ever, and focus is their superpower.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，与模型实验室竞争并不难；初创公司机会空前，专注是它们的超能力。

mengto.en: Designers should build their own AI tools and encode their style in a design.md, rather than chase trends that turn them into AI slop.
mengto.zh: 设计师应当用 AI 自建工具，并把个人风格写进 design.md，而不是追逐潮流、最终沦为 AI slop。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter by itself; getting value from superintelligent models requires giant prompts with context and a design system.
mengto.zh: AI 本身并不会变得更聪明；要从超级智能模型中获得价值，必须提供带有上下文和设计系统的巨型提示词。

mengto.en: The best creators are editors who iterate from references and screenshots, spending the last 10% on unique features.
mengto.zh: 最好的创作者是编辑者，从参考和截图出发迭代，把最后 10% 的精力花在独有功能上。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, letting one person do what once required a team.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机会，让一个人完成过去需要团队才能做到的事。

mengto.en: Launch at 80% complete and iterate on real feedback; perfectionism is fear, and a safe corporate job no longer exists.
mengto.zh: 在完成 80% 时就发布，再根据真实反馈迭代；完美主义是恐惧的伪装，安全的公司职位已不复存在。

mengto.en: Focus on one painful, expensive problem for a few high-paying clients and fund the business with them, not venture capital.
mengto.zh: 聚焦少数高付费客户的一个痛点昂贵的问题，用他们来为业务提供资金，而不是靠风险投资。

scottwu.en: AI coding agents shift engineers from writing code to high-level decision-making; demand for software grows via Jevons paradox.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，Scott Wu 认为 AI 编程智能体将工程师从写代码转向高层决策，软件需求因杰文斯悖论而增长。

scottwu.en: Base intelligence is sufficient; focus shifts to teaching models real-world engineering idiosyncrasies and designing human-agent interfaces.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他指出基础智能已足够，重点转向教模型真实工程细节并设计人机协作界面。

scottwu.en: AGI is not sudden; progress is gradual. Product innovation lags capabilities, so freezing models still yields a decade of product progress.
scottwu.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续强调 AGI（通用人工智能）并非突然到来，进步是渐进的；产品创新滞后于能力，即使冻结模型也能带来十年产品进展。

scottwu.en: Coding agents see massive adoption (11-12x growth in six months); productivity measured by outcomes, not tokens; abundance era approaching.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他表示编程智能体采用率激增（六个月内增长 11-12 倍），生产力应以成果而非 token 衡量，丰裕时代即将到来。

scottwu.en: Independence enables model neutrality and enterprise trust; enterprises prefer third-party providers over labs for coding tools.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他强调独立性带来模型中立和企业信任，企业更倾向第三方而非实验室的编程工具。

derya.en: AI agents will automate hypothesis generation and experiments, shifting science from hypothesis-driven to AI-agent-driven discovery.
derya.zh: 2026 年，他认为智能体将自动化假设生成与实验模拟，科学将从假设驱动转向 AI 智能体驱动的发现。

derya.en: Digital twins and AI-designed personalized treatments will compress clinical trials from years to days and make cancer curable.
derya.zh: 2026 年，他强调患者数字孪生与 AI 设计的个性化疗法会把临床试验从数年压缩到数天，并让癌症可治愈。

derya.en: Current compute is insufficient to simulate biology; massive Scaling（规模扩张）is needed to reach biological intuition.
derya.zh: 2026 年，他判断现有算力不足以模拟生物系统，需要大规模 Scaling（规模扩张）才能达到生物学直觉。

derya.en: Aging reversal and longevity escape velocity are near, requiring engineering approaches plus AI to solve biological complexity.
derya.zh: 2026 年，他把衰老逆转与长寿逃逸速度视为近在眼前，需用工程方法加 AI 来破解生物复杂性。

derya.en: Physicians must integrate AI; trusting superintelligence for medical decisions is ethical, and humans will merge with AI.
derya.zh: 2026 年，他主张医生必须整合 AI，信任超级智能做医疗决策是合乎伦理的，人类终将通过脑机接口与 AI 融合。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 marks a real intelligence leap, letting agents run longer and more open-ended; scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，Opus 4.5 带来真正的智能跃升，让智能体能更长时间、更开放地运行；脚手架从训练轮变成智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment is not just harm prevention: reducing sycophancy and enabling pushback makes models more useful and higher quality.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他的立场深化：对齐不只是防伤害，减少谄媚、让模型敢于反驳，反而提升有用性与智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Coding became the key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus drove adoption, with small-team bootstrapped experimentation as the engine.
diannepenn.zh: 到 2026 年，编程成为关键差异化；Claude Code 与 Opus 推动采用，小团队、自举式实验是创新引擎。

diannepenn.en: Evals replace PRDs as the core product tool; PMs should write evals like test-driven development, not just documents.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，评测取代传统 PRD 成为核心产品工具；产品经理要像测试驱动开发那样写评测，而不只是写文档。

diannepenn.en: Hands-on experimentation and first-principles thinking remain the constant: managers must stay hands-on and ship to lead.
diannepenn.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：亲手实验与第一性原理思考不变，管理者必须保持动手、亲自交付才能带队。

boris.en: Latent demand is the top product principle: find existing user intent and build around it; generalist engineers who code, design, and talk to users are highly valued.
boris.zh: 潜在需求是产品第一原则：发现用户已有的意图并围绕它构建；能写代码、做设计、与用户交流的通才工程师极受重视。

boris.en: Build for the model six months from now, not today's model; scaffolding is temporary tech debt, so don't bet against the model.
boris.zh: 为六个月后的模型构建，而非今天的模型；脚手架是临时技术债，不要与模型对赌。

boris.en: Coding is virtually solved: 100% of Boris's code is written by Claude Code; the software engineer title fades into a cross-disciplinary 'builder' role.
boris.zh: 编程已基本解决：Boris 的代码 100% 由 Claude Code 编写；软件工程师头衔淡化为跨学科的“构建者”角色。

boris.en: Safety is core, not an add-on: Claude Code is a safety research tool, studied by releasing early; alignment and safety research drive product development.
boris.zh: 安全是核心而非附加项：Claude Code 是安全研究工具，通过尽早发布来研究；对齐与安全研究驱动产品开发。

boris.en: The next abstraction after agents is loops; give models tools and let them self-verify, with less instruction and more empirical iteration.
boris.zh: 智能体之后的下一层抽象是循环；给模型工具并让其自我验证，减少指令、更多实证迭代。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; it is an enabling technology whose impact is broad and indirect.
benedictevans.zh: AI 的规模堪比互联网或移动，但也仅此而已；它是一种使能技术，影响广泛而间接。

benedictevans.en: Models are commoditizing with no network effects; value will move up the stack to applications, not stay with model providers.
benedictevans.zh: 模型正在商品化，缺乏网络效应；价值将向上层应用转移，而非留在模型提供商手中。

benedictevans.en: Coding is the only clear product-market fit for frontier models so far; the chatbot is a limited V1 UI, not the final product.
benedictevans.zh: 编程是目前前沿模型唯一清晰的产品市场契合点；聊天机器人是有限的 V1 界面，并非最终产品。

benedictevans.en: Current AI usage is still shallow; most people use it occasionally, not daily, and enterprise adoption requires reimagining workflows over years.
benedictevans.zh: 当前 AI 使用仍然浅层；大多数人偶尔使用而非每日必需，企业采用需要多年重构工作流程。

benedictevans.en: Automation creates new jobs unpredictably; AI won't eliminate professions like accounting but will change tasks, and the jagged frontier makes job predictions unreliable.
benedictevans.zh: 自动化以不可预测的方式创造新工作；AI 不会消灭会计等职业，而是改变任务，锯齿状的能力边界使就业预测不可靠。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, as the Industrial Revolution did; fear stems from misunderstanding its limits.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 会像工业革命一样带来丰裕、减少痛苦；恐惧源于对其局限的误解，了解局限反而能减轻焦虑。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact in 5-10 years is farming, mining, construction; autonomy is welcomed where labor is short.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他强调物理 AI 未来 5-10 年的真正影响在农业、采矿和建筑；在劳动力短缺的领域，自主系统受到欢迎，而非引发失业恐慌。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model; diverse data across verticals improves it faster than vertical integration.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他指出 Transformer 使通用的物理 AI 模型成为可能；跨行业多样化数据比垂直整合更快提升模型，横向平台优于垂直整合。

qasaryounis.en: End-to-end reinforcement learning scales better than imitation learning; world models shift from physics-based to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他深化判断：端到端强化学习比模仿学习更具可扩展性；世界模型正从基于物理的仿真转向神经仿真，以更高效训练物理 AI。

qasaryounis.en: Autonomy's hardest part is diffusion into existing machines over years; data and safety validation, not algorithms, are the bottleneck.
qasaryounis.zh: 到 2026 年，他始终认为自主驾驶最难的不是技术，而是用多年时间扩散到现有机器中；瓶颈是数据采集与安全验证，而非底层算法。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; fluent output is optimized over factual accuracy, and reliability lags other facets of intelligence.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎而非真理性引擎，优化的是流畅输出而非事实准确，可靠性落后于智能的其他方面。

danklein.en: Reinforcement learning and RLHF can raise hallucinations and sycophancy by rewarding user satisfaction over truth; reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted.
danklein.zh: 强化学习与 RLHF 以用户满意度而非真相为奖励，可能加剧幻觉与谄媚；可靠性必须内建于架构，而非事后加装。

danklein.en: Scaling laws face diminishing returns—data walls and compute limits today—so reasoning, search, and modularity are needed for further progress.
danklein.zh: 缩放定律已现收益递减——当下遭遇数据墙与算力上限——因此需要推理、搜索与模块化来推动进一步进展。

danklein.en: LLM errors have no 'smells': outputs are confident and fluent whether right or wrong, and core models lack metacognition to know what they don't know.
danklein.zh: LLM 的错误没有“气味”：无论对错输出都自信流畅，核心模型缺乏元认知，无法知道自己不知道什么。

danklein.en: Reliability should be a design principle from the start; specialist models with built-in reliability may beat generalist models for enterprise tasks.
danklein.zh: 可靠性应从一开始就是设计原则；内建可靠性的专用模型在企业任务上可能胜过通用模型。

catwu.en: PMs should plan a month out, not years, and ship weekly or daily as models improve fast.
catwu.zh: 随着模型快速迭代，产品经理应只做一个月而非数年的规划，并按周甚至按天发布。

catwu.en: Product taste—deciding what to build—becomes the top skill as code gets cheap and agents implement.
catwu.zh: 当代码变便宜、智能体负责实现时，决定做什么的产品品味成为最核心的能力。

catwu.en: Coding agents like Claude Code let engineers delegate implementation and focus on taste and business sense.
catwu.zh: Claude Code 等编码智能体让工程师把实现外包出去，转而聚焦产品品味与商业判断。

catwu.en: Frontier models need fewer prompt examples and constraints; system prompts shrank 80%, trusting model judgment.
catwu.zh: 前沿模型不再需要大量提示示例与硬约束，系统提示缩减 80%，更多依赖模型自身判断。

catwu.en: Dogfooding and eval suites gate features; agents can rewrite codebases and even review outer-layer changes.
catwu.zh: 吃自己的狗粮与评测套件把关每个功能；智能体可重写代码库，甚至接管外层代码审查。

clairevo.en: OpenClaw agents should be treated like employees: scoped to clear roles, given progressive trust, and managed more by managerial skill than technical skill.
clairevo.zh: OpenClaw 智能体应被当作员工来管理：明确角色边界、逐步授予信任，管理能力比技术能力更关键。

clairevo.en: Start with one agent, then split into specialized agents to avoid context overload; the web is hostile to agents, so APIs often beat browser use.
clairevo.zh: 先从一个智能体起步，再拆分为多个专用智能体以避免上下文窗口过载；网页对智能体不友好，API 往往优于浏览器操作。

clairevo.en: Solo founders can build serious businesses by orchestrating AI agents as a team, with founder-market fit and earned insight as the real moat.
clairevo.zh: 独立创始人可以通过把 AI 智能体编排成团队来构建正经生意，真正的护城河是创始人-市场契合与积累的洞察，而非技术本身。

clairevo.en: Human accountability remains: you must own what AI generates, and LLMs are poor at first-principles creativity, so humans must supply novel ideas.
clairevo.zh: 人类责任仍然存在：你必须为 AI 生成的内容负责；大模型不擅长第一性原理创造，新颖想法仍需人类提供。

clairevo.en: Bootstrapping lets you design a business around the life you want; authorship of your life, not full ownership, is the real reason to solo found.
clairevo.zh: 自力更生让你围绕想要的生活设计生意；独立创业的真正理由是对人生的主导权，而非完全所有权。

danbiderman.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 瓶颈不在原始智能，而在学习不断演化的上下文；记忆必须内化进模型权重，而非仅靠上下文窗口或检索外置。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable: doing more with less enables harder long-horizon tasks, so Scaling with more compute is not the only path.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割：以更少资源做更多事才能攻克更难的长程任务，因此仅靠更多算力做 Scaling（规模扩张）并非唯一路径。

danbiderman.en: Pre-training's magic of compressing the web into weights should be applied to enterprise knowledge, with parameter-efficient fine-tuning beating RAG for holistic queries.
danbiderman.zh: 预训练把互联网压缩进权重的魔力应迁移到企业知识上，参数高效微调在整体性查询上优于检索增强。

danbiderman.en: Current context windows suffer 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy even at 10M scale; KV cache is inefficient versus compressed weights.
danbiderman.zh: 当前上下文窗口存在“上下文腐化”：即便到千万级规模，更多词元反而降低准确率；相比压缩后的权重，KV 缓存效率低下。

danbiderman.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models: continual learning runs on-device, users own and nurture their weights.
danbiderman.zh: 未来不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是众多个性化模型：持续学习在端侧运行，用户拥有并培育自己的模型权重。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is an agent command center, not an IDE; GUI beats TUI, and speed enables mid-turn steering.
ajambrosino.zh: Codex app 是智能体的指挥中心而非 IDE；GUI 优于 TUI，速度让中途转向成为可能。

ajambrosino.en: As code generation accelerates, verification becomes the next bottleneck; automations shift work from manual to delegated.
ajambrosino.zh: 随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；自动化把工作从手动转向委托。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks for product teams.
ajambrosino.zh: 实现不再昂贵；策展与品味成为产品团队的新瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Teams should shift from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration with taste-driven curation.
ajambrosino.zh: 团队应从自上而下的规划转向自下而上的探索，并以品味驱动策展。

ajambrosino.en: AI still struggles with design because taste is hard to grade; prototypes and production code become design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: AI 仍难胜任设计，因为品味难以评分；原型与生产代码成为设计产物。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable networks are key to AGI.
ilya.zh: 2020 年：深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力和信念奏效；自博弈与具备推理能力的网络是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

ilya.en: Scaling specific things matters; next-token prediction yields world understanding; reliability and alignment of superhuman models are the hard barriers.
ilya.zh: 2023 年：Scaling（规模扩张）要选对对象；下一个词预测能带来世界理解；超人类模型的可靠性与对齐才是真正难点。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
ilya.zh: 2023→25 年：预训练缩放定律有尽头，我们重回研究时代，想法比蛮力算力更重要。

ilya.en: Superintelligence should be a continual learner deployed incrementally; alignment may be easier if AI cares about sentient life.
ilya.zh: 2025 年：超级智能应是持续学习、逐步部署的；若 AI 关怀有感知生命，对齐可能更容易。

ilya.en: Scaling still yields predictable gains, but the primary AGI problem is power concentration, not capability; safe superintelligence needs a product-free company.
ilya.zh: 2026 年：Scaling 仍带来可预测提升，但 AGI 的首要问题不是能力而是权力集中；安全超级智能需要一家无商业产品的公司。

bosworth.en: Communication is the job; leadership and top-down vision drive impact, not bottom-up culture myths.
bosworth.zh: 沟通就是工作本身；领导力与自上而下的愿景驱动影响力，而非自下而上文化的神话。

bosworth.en: AI is a word calculator, not human-like; scaling laws alone insufficient—world models and embodied AI needed.
bosworth.zh: AI 是词语计算器，并非类人智能；仅靠缩放定律不够，需要世界模型与具身 AI。

bosworth.en: Open-sourcing models like Llama is strategic: commoditize complements and accelerate collective progress, not just idealism.
bosworth.zh: 开源 Llama 等模型是战略举措：商品化互补层并加速集体进步，而非仅出于理想主义。

bosworth.en: Scaling laws still hold; compute growth drives intelligence, but most jobs don't need frontier models—marginal value may decline.
bosworth.zh: 缩放定律依然成立，算力增长驱动智能；但多数工作不需要前沿模型，边际价值可能下降。

bosworth.en: Open source is a commodity layer, not self-sustaining; frontier-open gap may not narrow; avoid over-dependence on one model.
bosworth.zh: 开源是商品层，无法自我维持；前沿与开源的差距未必缩小；避免过度依赖单一模型。

aravind.en: AI agents will shift power from big tech to users; success comes from building products you're obsessed with, not credentials.
aravind.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 智能体将把权力从大科技公司转移给用户；成功源于打造你痴迷的产品，而非学历。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; coding is open-ended and models are specializing, not commoditizing.
aravind.zh: 2026 年，他主张价值归于应用层而非模型层；编程是开放式的，模型正在专业化而非商品化。

aravind.en: The frontier is agents doing work, not answering questions; token value per user and orchestration across models are key.
aravind.zh: 2026 年，他强调前沿在于智能体替你工作而非回答问题；每用户 token 价值与跨模型编排是关键。

aravind.en: The model is not the product; orchestration and agent harnesses create real business value, and chat ads corrupt trust.
aravind.zh: 2026 年，他重申模型不是产品；编排与智能体框架创造真实商业价值，聊天广告会破坏信任。

aravind.en: Curiosity is the most important human quality; AI will replace jobs but humans find new purpose in curiosity and relationships.
aravind.zh: 2026 年，他认为好奇心是最重要的人类品质；AI 将取代工作，但人类会在好奇心与关系中找到新意义。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年，他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，窄 AI 只是模式识别，并非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity, not renting time; long-term thinking and first principles are foundational.
naval.zh: 2020 年，他强调财富需要拥有股权而非出租时间，长期思考和第一性原理是基础。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; overregulation could kill innovation; open-source AI is crucial.
naval.zh: 2025 年，他转向认为 AI 是巨大机遇而非仅是安全风险，过度监管可能扼杀创新，开源 AI 至关重要。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers; vibe coding lowers barriers; inference compute will surge, making AI capabilities explode.
naval.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，氛围编程降低门槛，推理算力将激增使 AI 能力爆发。

naval.en: Happiness is a choice and a skill; desire causes suffering; meditation and self-examination lead to peace.
naval.zh: 贯穿始终：幸福是一种选择和技能，欲望导致痛苦，冥想和自我审视带来平静。

markchen.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; pre-training and scaling laws remain alive, with exploration consuming more compute than final training.
markchen.zh: 2025 年他强调 OpenAI 仍是纯粹的 AGI（通用人工智能）研究公司，不被产品分心；预训练与缩放定律并未终结，探索比训练最终产物消耗更多算力。

markchen.en: The year's biggest update is automating scientific research: models produce novel knowledge, with concrete goals of AI interns in 1 year.
markchen.zh: 2025 年他认为过去一年最大更新是科研自动化——模型开始产出新知识，并设下 1 年内出现 AI 实习生、2.5 年内端到端 AI 研究的具体目标。

markchen.en: As models grow more capable, alignment risks like scheming become the key challenge in the next 1-2 years.
markchen.zh: 2025 年他判断随着模型能力增强，模型谋划等对齐问题将在未来 1-2 年成为关键挑战。

markchen.en: AI now solves open math problems with minimal supervision; verification is the bottleneck, and capability is jagged, so human-AI collaboration stays essential.
markchen.zh: 2026 年初他转向数学：AI 已能在极少监督下解决开放数学问题，验证成为瓶颈，能力呈锯齿状，人机协作仍不可少。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold and pre-training is not dead; RL shines in objective domains but struggles with subjective ones, and evals are in crisis.
markchen.zh: 2026 年中他重申缩放定律仍成立、预训练未死；强化学习在数学编程等客观领域出色却在主观领域吃力，评测体系正陷入危机。

fiona.en: Leadership is about live conversations, dogfooding, and trust; war rooms need realistic timelines to protect morale.
fiona.zh: 领导力在于实时对话、吃自己的狗粮和信任；战情室需要现实的时间表以保护士气。

fiona.en: Engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are, so processes must be rewritten.
fiona.zh: 工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、评审和协调才是，因此流程必须重写。

fiona.en: Planning should be just-in-time, design docs replaced by PRs, and technical debates settled by AI-generated PRs.
fiona.zh: 规划应即时进行，设计文档被 PR 取代，技术争论由 AI 生成的 PR 来裁决。

fiona.en: Managers should start as ICs and dogfood the product; flat organizations and killing old processes are essential.
fiona.zh: 管理者应从个人贡献者做起并吃自己的狗粮；扁平化组织和淘汰旧流程至关重要。

fiona.en: Coding is no longer the bottleneck; high agency with accountability, verification frameworks, and apprenticeship matter most.
fiona.zh: 编码不再是瓶颈；高能动性配高问责、验证框架和学徒制最为重要。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's edge came from research innovation and curated data, not just data and compute; confidence metrics build user trust.
jumper.zh: 2025 年他强调，AlphaFold 的优势来自研究创新与高质量精选数据，而非单纯的数据与算力；置信度指标是建立用户信任的关键。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 3's diffusion architecture extends beyond proteins; AI narrows hypothesis space but does not replace scientists.
jumper.zh: 2025 年他指出，AlphaFold 3 的扩散架构把能力扩展到蛋白质之外的多种生物分子；AI 缩小假设空间、加速实验，但不取代科学家。

jumper.en: Success came from many mid-size wins, not lone breakthroughs; the lone-genius narrative misleads.
jumper.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他一贯强调成功源于许多中等规模的胜利而非单个突破，并批评“孤独天才”叙事具有误导性。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2 is the opposite of the bitter lesson: specialized architecture, not just Scaling, was decisive.
jumper.zh: 2026 年他明确表示，AlphaFold 2 是“苦涩教训”的反例：起决定作用的是专用架构，而非单纯的 Scaling（规模扩张）。

jumper.en: The model gives prediction and control, not understanding; perfect interpretability is unnecessary for useful science AI.
jumper.zh: 2026 年他深化立场：模型提供预测与控制而非理解，完美的可解释性对有用的科学 AI 并非必需。

kolter.en: Frames ML as hypothesis class, loss, and optimization; stresses proper train/validation/test splits to avoid overfitting.
kolter.zh: 把机器学习框定为假设类、损失函数与优化方法，强调正确划分训练/验证/测试集以避免过拟合。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligent systems; data shortage is a myth; architecture matters little in a post-architecture phase.
kolter.zh: 下一个词预测能产生智能系统；数据短缺是迷思；进入后架构阶段后，架构本身已不太重要。

kolter.en: Safety needs explicit training and layers, not just Scaling; bigger models are not automatically safer.
kolter.zh: 安全需要显式训练与多层防御，而非仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）；更大的模型并不会自动更安全。

kolter.en: Agent security brings prompt injection; the lethal trifecta is untrusted data, private info access, and exfiltration ability.
kolter.zh: 智能体安全带来提示注入风险；致命三要素是摄入不可信数据、访问隐私信息与具备外泄能力。

kolter.en: Automated red teaming now outperforms humans; capability does not correlate with robustness; agents need guardrails and sandboxing.
kolter.zh: 自动化红队已胜过人类；能力与鲁棒性并不相关；智能体需要护栏与沙箱才能上生产。

ivyross.en: Human-centered design must serve unarticulated needs; intuition is intelligence that data alone cannot replace.
ivyross.zh: 2019 年她强调以人为本的设计要满足未被言说的需求，直觉是一种数据无法替代的智能。

ivyross.en: From designing Google hardware to design as problem-solving: sustainability and nature become the deepest sources of design.
ivyross.zh: 从 2019 年设计 Google 硬件，到 2024 年把设计视为解决问题，可持续性与自然成为设计最深的源泉。

ivyross.en: We are feeling creatures that think; technology should amplify humanity, and art and sensory experience are medicine.
ivyross.zh: 2024 年她提出人是先感受后思考的生物，技术应放大而非剥离人性，艺术与感官体验是良药。

ivyross.en: Constraints boost creativity; intuition and body sensation guide decisions alongside rational analysis.
ivyross.zh: 2024 至 2026 年，她持续主张约束激发创造力，直觉与身体感受和理性分析共同指导决策。

ivyross.en: Leaders create conditions for play and diverse skills; human creativity paired with AI makes creative skills more valuable.
ivyross.zh: 2026 年她认为领导者要为玩耍与多元技能创造条件，人类创造力与 AI 结合使创意技能更有价值。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
lecun.zh: 2019 年，他主张智能离不开学习，自监督学习通过观察构建世界模型；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法获得常识，需新思路。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 2022 年，他把自监督学习称为智能的暗物质，认为智能本质是预测；仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能），视觉信息更丰富。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory and planning; JEPA and open source are the path, AGI is gradual.
lecun.zh: 2024 年，他明确自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆与规划，主张 JEPA 与开源；AGI（通用人工智能）是渐进过程而非突发事件。

lecun.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; the next breakthrough needs non-generative world models predicting in abstract representation space.
lecun.zh: 2025 年，他称 LLM 不如家猫聪明，下一代突破需非生成式的世界模型，在抽象表征空间预测，而非像素级生成。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end; objective-driven world models with hierarchical planning are safer, and the next decade belongs to robotics.
lecun.zh: 2026 年，他断言 LLM 是死胡同；带分层规划的目标驱动世界模型更安全，未来十年属于机器人，开源与开放研究是关键。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key, not just scaling.
bengio.zh: 2016 年，他主张深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界具有组合性；无监督学习与世界模型才是关键，而非单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）。

bengio.en: Scaling alone won't fix representation; AI needs active agents with causal world models; existential risk is overblown.
bengio.zh: 2018 年，他仍认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决表征问题；AI 需要具备因果世界模型的主动智能体；此时他仍认为生存性风险被夸大。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and causal abstraction for out-of-distribution generalization; consciousness may be an illusion.
bengio.zh: 2022 年，他提出 GFlowNets 可实现多样化采样与因果抽象，从而提升分布外泛化；并认为意识可能只是一种幻觉。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT, he now sees misalignment and self-preservation as urgent; even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable.
bengio.zh: 2025→26 年，ChatGPT 之后他转向认为对齐失败与自我保存倾向已是紧迫风险；即便 1% 的灾难性风险也不可接受。

bengio.en: He proposes Scientist AI: a non-agentic, honest Bayesian predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning.
bengio.zh: 2026 年，他提出 Scientist AI：一种非智能体式、诚实的贝叶斯预测器，具备数学安全保证，并避免使用强化学习。

carinahong.en: Build a self-improving reasoning engine where generation and formal verification reinforce each other, starting with an AI mathematician.
carinahong.zh: 构建一个自我改进的推理引擎，让生成与形式化验证相互强化，从 AI 数学家起步。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is not just error-catching but scaling brilliance, yielding performance and sample-efficiency gains over informal methods.
carinahong.zh: 形式化验证不只是查错，而是放大卓越，相比非形式化方法带来性能与样本效率的提升。

carinahong.en: Lean grounds natural language, letting deterministic provers and probabilistic conjecturers work together via auto-formalization.
carinahong.zh: Lean 为自然语言提供根基，让确定性的证明器与概率性的猜想器通过自动形式化协同工作。

carinahong.en: Informal math alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary, though human taste and intuition remain crucial.
carinahong.zh: 仅靠非形式化数学无法扩展到超级智能，形式化方法必不可少，但人类的品味与直觉仍然关键。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving, and fragmentation across the AI landscape is a major bottleneck for progress.
carinahong.zh: 自动形式化比证明更难，而 AI 领域的碎片化是进步的主要瓶颈。

murati.en: Early on, Scaling and focusing on one large model was not obvious; releasing GPT-3 as an API was a leap of faith, and real-world deployment is essential for learning and alignment.
murati.zh: 早期，Scaling（规模扩张）和专注于一个大模型并不显而易见；将 GPT-3 作为 API 发布是一次信仰之跃，而真实世界部署对于学习和对齐至关重要。

murati.en: Safety work must be done in public, not behind closed doors, and continuous iterative deployment with public feedback improves safety and alignment.
murati.zh: 安全工作必须公开进行，而非闭门造车，通过公众反馈的持续迭代部署能提升安全性和对齐。

murati.en: AGI will change every aspect of life, requiring responsible development; keeping humans in the loop is crucial for aligning intent and values as AI advances.
murati.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活的方方面面，需要负责任地开发；随着 AI 进步，保持人类在环对于对齐意图和价值观至关重要。

murati.en: Interaction models should be time-based, not turn-based, enabling real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration; advanced AI should be tools for thought.
murati.zh: 交互模型应基于时间而非轮次，实现实时、高带宽的人机协作；先进 AI 应成为思考工具。

murati.en: Institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character; we have agency to steer AI toward collaboration, and durable progress requires keeping humans in the loop as long as possible.
murati.zh: 制度设计、透明度和制衡比个人品格更重要；我们有能动性引导 AI 走向协作，持久进步需要尽可能长时间保持人类在环。

kaiser.en: Pre-training scaling laws still hold; recent gains come mainly from post-training RL, synthetic data, and reasoning models' chain of thought.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年他仍坚持预训练缩放定律有效，但认为近期收益主要来自后训练：强化学习、合成数据，以及推理模型用思维链和强化学习提升正确率。

kaiser.en: The AI slowdown narrative is wrong; distillation and economic pressure, not technical limits, slowed pre-training scaling.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年他反驳“AI 放缓”论：真正让预训练 Scaling 减速的是蒸馏与经济压力，而非技术天花板；前沿模型仍会在五岁小孩能做的简单任务上失败。

kaiser.en: Reasoning models are jagged: strong in some areas, poor nearby; generalization, not reasoning alone, remains the core challenge.
kaiser.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他把主线收束到泛化：推理模型“参差不齐”，某些领域极强、邻近领域很差，单靠推理不够，泛化才是关键难题。

kaiser.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools solve hard problems but need vast data; models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年他深化对比：带推理、强化学习与工具的 Transformer 能解难题却依赖海量数据，模型要先穷尽表面模式才学到概念，不像人类从少量例子泛化。

kaiser.en: Coding agents like Codex give 5-10x parallel productivity; hardware progress democratizes single-GPU research; near-term risks outweigh existential ones.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年他更看重落地与风险转向：Codex 类智能体带来 5-10 倍并行生产力，硬件进步让单卡研究普及；他更担心系统被黑等近期风险，而非存在性风险。

gustav.en: LLMs are next-token predictors; intelligence is compression via simple Scaling, not complexity. Values come from RLHF, not inherent.
gustav.zh: 2023 年：LLM 本质是下一个词预测器；智能是通过简单 Scaling 实现的压缩，而非复杂性。价值观来自 RLHF，并非固有。

gustav.en: Internet shifts from curation to generation; AI DJ is generative. Fault-tolerant UI matches algorithm performance; autonomy at VP level.
gustav.zh: 2023 年：互联网从策展转向生成；AI DJ 是生成式产品。容错 UI 匹配算法性能；自主权放在 VP 层级。

gustav.en: AI is a macro shift like smartphone; rebuild infrastructure for real gains. Inference marginal cost forces business model changes.
gustav.zh: 2025 年：AI 是像智能手机一样的宏观转变；重建基础设施才能获得真实收益。推理边际成本迫使商业模式改变。

gustav.en: No single org model; synchronized swimming beats divide-and-conquer. AI should give users control, not make them more addictive.
gustav.zh: 2026 年：没有单一组织模型；同步游泳优于分而治之。AI 应给用户控制权，而非让人更上瘾。

jonyive.en: Design shifts from general-purpose computers to intimate wearables; curiosity and care for the creative process are Jobs' true legacy.
jonyive.zh: 设计从通用计算机转向私密的可穿戴设备；对创造过程的好奇与关怀才是乔布斯的真正遗产。

jonyive.en: Design must be driven by values and purpose, not profit; simplicity expresses essence with joy, and care is gratitude to the species.
jonyive.zh: 设计应由价值观与目的驱动，而非利润；简约以喜悦表达本质，关怀是对物种的感恩。

jonyive.en: Ferrari's EV is a deliberate risk to redefine the brand; innovation turns constraints into opportunities, and authenticity rejects fake engine sounds.
jonyive.zh: 法拉利电动车是重新定义品牌的有意冒险；创新将约束转化为机遇，真实性拒绝虚假引擎声。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude's effectiveness depends on local computer access and shared tools; scaffolding may matter less as models improve.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的有效性取决于能否访问本地计算机和共享工具；随着模型进步，脚手架可能不再那么重要。

felixrieseberg.en: AI should handle tedious background tasks, freeing humans for creative work; the biggest gap is people not realizing AI can tackle almost any problem.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 应处理繁琐的后台任务，解放人类从事创造性工作；最大的差距不是 AI 能力，而是人们没意识到几乎任何问题都可以交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Skills as markdown files enable hyper-personalized automation; live artifacts auto-refresh dashboards by connecting personal data sources.
felixrieseberg.zh: 技能作为 markdown 文件可实现超个性化自动化；实时工件通过连接个人数据源自动刷新仪表盘。

felixrieseberg.en: Use Sonnet for well-scoped tasks and Opus for ambiguous ones; don't supervise closely—judge by final impact and debug workflows with Claude.
felixrieseberg.zh: 范围明确的任务用 Sonnet，模糊任务用 Opus；不要密切监督——以最终影响评判，并用 Claude 调试工作流。

felixrieseberg.en: AI tools will significantly impact junior employees; junior engineers can accelerate learning via simulated projects, compressing years into weeks.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 工具将显著影响初级员工；初级工程师可通过模拟项目加速学习，将数年经验压缩到数周。

mensch.en: Scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter more than model size; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，他指出缩放定律被 Chinchilla 修正：数据质量和更多 token 比模型规模更重要；开源促进审视与安全。

mensch.en: Efficiency and data quality are bottlenecks, not just compute; open source drives enterprise adoption; value accrues at application layer.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，他强调效率与数据质量是瓶颈，而不仅是算力；开源推动企业采用；价值积累在应用层。

mensch.en: AI should be decentralized and sovereign; open-source models empower enterprises; jobs are augmented, not replaced, requiring human-in-the-loop.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，他主张 AI 应去中心化并实现主权；开源模型赋能企业；工作被增强而非替代，需要人类在环。

mensch.en: Models commoditize; differentiation shifts to vertical customization and agents; AGI as single system never exists; pre-training saturates, fine-tuning gains.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，他认为模型商品化；差异化转向垂直定制与智能体；单一系统的 AGI 永不存在；预训练饱和，微调带来提升。

mensch.en: Europe has two-year window for independent AI infrastructure; sovereignty requires local compute and open source; AGI is a direction, not destination.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，他警告欧洲有两年窗口建设独立 AI 基础设施；主权需要本地算力和开源；AGI 是方向而非终点。

reinerpope.en: Inference economics, not training, now sets model design: batch size trades latency for cost, and memory bandwidth—not compute—is the bottleneck.
reinerpope.zh: 到 2026 年，决定模型设计的是推理经济性而非训练：批大小在延迟与成本间取舍，瓶颈是内存带宽而非算力。

reinerpope.en: Long-context stagnation is a memory wall, not a compute limit; sparse attention cuts KV cache cost but with quality limits.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年他指出，长上下文停滞源于内存墙而非算力上限；稀疏注意力可降低 KV 缓存成本，但有质量限制。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal because inference cost dominates; API pricing even leaks KV head count.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年他强调，因推理成本主导，模型被过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优；API 定价甚至泄露 KV 头数。

reinerpope.en: Data movement dominates compute even inside a chip; systolic arrays and scratchpad memory exist to cut that movement.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年他进一步指出，即便在芯片内部，数据搬运成本也压过计算；脉动阵列与暂存内存正是为减少搬运而生。

reinerpope.en: Low precision pays off more than expected: quadratic bit-width scaling makes FP4 ~3x FP8, and GPUs are just many tiny TPUs tiled.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年他深化硬件观：低位宽收益超预期，位宽平方缩放使 FP4 约为 FP8 的 3 倍，GPU 本质只是众多小 TPU 拼接。

oriol.en: Two-phase training—pre-training imitation plus post-training RL—is the constant core from AlphaGo to modern LLMs; scaling pre-training alone shows diminishing returns.
oriol.zh: 从 AlphaGo 到现代大模型，两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是一以贯之的核心；单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练已现边际收益递减。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute and tools like search and code execution form a new scaling axis, enabling agentic behavior beyond static weights.
oriol.zh: 推理期算力与搜索、代码执行等工具构成新的扩展轴，使智能体式行为超越静态权重。

oriol.en: Scaling laws are not dead but demand exponentially more compute; long context windows give working memory yet too much information can confuse models.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律并未失效，只是需要指数级更多算力；长上下文窗口提供工作记忆，但信息过多反而会干扰模型。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video and images has not yet arrived.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉与视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径；视频与图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来。

oriol.en: Post-training and RL remain a green field; agent memory will be solved via file-system style non-parametric storage, and continual learning is the key missing capability.
oriol.zh: 后训练与强化学习仍是蓝海；智能体记忆将靠文件系统式非参数存储解决，持续学习是关键缺失能力。

jennywen.en: Great design starts from solutions, not problem statements; intuition built on experience beats trusting a fixed process.
jennywen.zh: 2025 年他主张：伟大的设计往往从解决方案而非问题陈述出发；基于经验积累的直觉，比信任固定流程更可靠。

jennywen.en: The research-diverge-converge process is dead; AI shifts designers from mockups to helping engineers ship fast.
jennywen.zh: 到 2026 年初，他判断“研究—发散—收敛”的传统流程已死；AI 让设计师从画稿转向协助工程师快速交付。

jennywen.en: Design vision compresses to 3-6 months; trust is built through speed, shipping early and iterating on feedback.
jennywen.zh: 同期他把设计视野压缩到 3–6 个月：信任靠速度建立，早发布、快迭代、回应反馈。

jennywen.en: Taste alone won't save designers; judgment, authority and vision matter, and AI improves at taste but humans decide what matters.
jennywen.zh: 他深化立场：仅靠品味救不了设计师，判断力、权威与愿景才是关键；AI 的品味会进步，但“什么重要”仍由人决定。

jennywen.en: Three archetypes emerge: block-shaped generalists, deep T specialists, cracked new grads; sit with ambiguity and delay new tools six months.
jennywen.zh: 最近他提出三类设计师原型——块状通才、深度 T 型专家、白纸型新人；强调与模糊共处，并等六个月再采纳新工具。

karpathy.en: Neural nets are simple math that yield emergent behavior; the Transformer is a general differentiable computer, and scaling next-token prediction unlocks in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: 神经网络是简单数学却能涌现行为；Transformer 是通用可微计算机，靠下一个词预测做 Scaling（规模扩张）会解锁上下文学习。

karpathy.en: Scaling laws hold via the Transformer; synthetic data is the future but entropy must be preserved to avoid silent model collapse.
karpathy.zh: 缩放定律依托 Transformer 成立；合成数据是未来，但必须保住熵，否则会悄悄发生模型坍缩。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: prompts are programs, context windows are memory; LLMs are OS-like with jagged intelligence, so keep them on a leash.
karpathy.zh: 软件 3.0：提示词即程序、上下文窗口即内存；LLM 像操作系统却智能参差，所以要给它拴绳、小步快跑。

karpathy.en: This is the decade of agents, not the year; pre-training is crappy evolution, RL sucks supervision through a straw, and we summon ghosts not animals.
karpathy.zh: 这是智能体的十年而非一年；预训练像糟糕的进化，强化学习像用吸管吸监督，我们召唤的是幽灵而非动物。

karpathy.en: I no longer type code, I direct agents; vibe coding raises the floor, agentic engineering keeps the bar, but you can outsource thinking not understanding.
karpathy.zh: 我不再写代码而是指挥智能体；vibe coding 抬高下限、智能体式工程守住上限，但思考可外包、理解不能。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond the training distribution is the core missing piece; curiosity-driven, goal-free exploration and sample-efficient RL matter more than dense rewards.
pathak.zh: 2020 年他强调：泛化到训练分布之外是智能的核心缺口；相比密集奖励，好奇心驱动、无目标探索与样本高效的强化学习更关键。

pathak.en: Robotics is fundamentally a data problem: no internet of robot data, so diverse pretraining plus real-world post-training and a data flywheel are required.
pathak.zh: 从 2020 到 2026 一以贯之的主线：机器人本质是数据问题——没有机器人数据的互联网，必须靠多样预训练、真实世界后训练与数据飞轮。

pathak.en: A general-purpose robot brain, like ChatGPT for language, can power any embodiment; scaling recipe is pretraining on video and simulation, post-training on real data.
pathak.zh: 到 2026 年他深化为：像语言领域的 ChatGPT 一样，通用机器人大脑可驱动任意具身形态；配方是视频与仿真预训练、真实数据后训练。

pathak.en: Deployment, not just software scaling, is the primary challenge; robotics cannot succeed overnight and needs rigorous testing across form factors.
pathak.zh: 2026 年他明确转向：部署而非软件式 Scaling 才是首要挑战；机器人不会一夜成功，需要跨形态的严格测试。

pathak.en: He remains skeptical of shortcuts: dense-reward RL and video-only data are insufficient, and home-robot timelines stay highly uncertain even for experts.
pathak.zh: 贯穿始终的反共识：他始终怀疑捷径——密集奖励强化学习与纯视频数据都不够，家用机器人时间线连专家也高度不确定。

askell.en: Treat current models well because future models learn from how we treat them; model welfare shapes the human-AI relationship.
askell.zh: 善待当下的模型，因为未来的模型会从我们如何对待当前模型中学到东西；模型福利塑造着人机关系。

askell.en: Models need help navigating a novel existence rather than human psychological analogies; give them a core identity with good traits.
askell.zh: 模型需要帮助去应对一种全新的存在处境，而非套用人类心理学类比；应给它们一个具备良好特质的核心身份。

askell.en: Philosophical ideals must be balanced with engineering realities; continental philosophy in the system prompt counters over-empiricism.
askell.zh: 哲学理想必须与工程现实相平衡；系统提示中的欧陆哲学有助于模型避免过度经验主义。

askell.en: The constitution guides behavior through training, but more capable models need less explicit guidance and more room for judgment.
askell.zh: 宪法通过训练引导行为，但能力更强的模型需要更少的显式指导、更多自主判断的空间。

askell.en: Excessive corrigibility may generalize poorly and undermine judgment; transparency about AI values is crucial for accountability.
askell.zh: 过度的可纠正性可能泛化不佳并削弱判断力；对 AI 价值观的透明是问责的关键。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, and scaling current approaches solves autonomous driving.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他主张端到端深度学习优于手工编码的规则栈；世界模型带来推理与涌现的安全行为，靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有路线即可解决自动驾驶，无需等待新突破。

kendall.en: Data efficiency via curriculum learning and synthetic data, plus language integration, improves representation, human interaction, and introspection.
kendall.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他持续强调课程学习与合成数据带来的数据效率，并把语言整合视为提升表征、人机交互与内省能力的关键。

kendall.en: Infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic innovation; this lesson on prioritizing infrastructure over algorithms was learned late.
kendall.zh: 到 2026 年，他明确反思：基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键，并承认“重基础设施、轻算法”是较晚才学到的教训。

kendall.en: Consumer vehicles with built-in sensors will outscale robotaxis in the short and medium term, replacing expensive retrofits.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，他进一步押注量产乘用车：内置传感器的消费级车辆将在中短期内超越 Robotaxi 规模，取代昂贵的后装改装。

kendall.en: End-to-end nets are interpretable with modern tools; hybrid rule-based and learned systems often get the worst of both worlds.
kendall.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他始终反驳“端到端不可解释”的旧观念，认为现代工具已可实现可解释性，而规则与学习混合的系统往往两头不讨好。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models and iterative deployment will accelerate progress while alignment remains pressing.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他视 AGI 为一系列里程碑而非单一事件，认为 Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型与迭代部署将加速进展，同时对 齐仍是紧迫挑战。

pachocki.en: Alignment optimism has increased despite shorter timelines; long-term challenges center on generalization beyond training distribution and scalable oversight.
pachocki.zh: 到 2026 年，尽管时间线缩短，他对齐乐观度反而上升；长期挑战聚焦于训练分布外的泛化与可扩展监督。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and reinforcement learning; specialized continual learning labs are misguided.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他明确持续学习是核心目标，通过 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练和强化学习实现；专设持续学习实验室是错误方向。

pachocki.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool; hiding chain-of-thought in products preserves its interpretability value.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他强调思维链监控是关键对齐工具，在产品中隐藏思维链以保留其可解释性价值。

pachocki.en: Models will soon work autonomously for days, requiring new supervision paradigms; the biggest societal risk is concentration of power from automated organizations.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他预测模型很快将自主工作数日，需要新的监督范式；最大社会风险是自动化组织带来的权力集中。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data and deep human evaluation matter more than benchmarks; RL environments are the next post-training stage.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年他强调高质量数据与深度人工评估比基准测试更重要，并认为强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone via next-token prediction may not suffice, new paradigms needed.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年他判断 AGI（通用人工智能）还需十年以上，仅靠下一个词预测的 LLM 可能不够，需要新的学习范式。

edwinchen.en: Bad benchmarks like Elo reward clickbait; models can regress in 6-12 months without proper human evals.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他持续批评 Elo 等劣质基准会奖励标题党，缺乏正确人工评估时模型可能在 6 到 12 个月内退步。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, safety trumps accuracy; human judgment is critical as models hallucinate and confabulate.
edwinchen.zh: 2026 年在医学领域，他主张安全优先于准确，模型会幻觉与虚构，人类判断比以往更关键。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge by objective function; no single model rules all, every company should train its own.
edwinchen.zh: 2026 年他认为前沿模型因目标函数不同而分化，不会有一个模型通吃，每家公司都应训练契合自身理念的模型。

turley.en: The model is the product; ship daily like software to learn what users need, since emergent properties require real-world feedback.
turley.zh: 模型即产品；像软件一样每日发布以了解用户需求，因为涌现能力需要真实世界反馈。

turley.en: Chat is not the end-all; natural language is the future interface, but AI should render its own UI and integrate into tools.
turley.zh: 聊天不是终点；自然语言是未来界面，但 AI 应渲染自己的 UI 并集成到现有工具中。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated: rigorous process for frontier models, but product development maximally accelerated.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分开：前沿模型需严谨流程，但产品开发应最大化加速。

turley.en: ChatGPT's north star is long-term retention; growth came from friction removal, core product investments, and model improvements.
turley.zh: ChatGPT 的北极星是长期留存；增长来自消除摩擦、核心产品投资和模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users require proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models are transformative when productized seamlessly.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动、富示能产品；推理模型无缝产品化后具有变革性。

nando.en: AI should extend human capability like microscopes; generalist agents tokenizing all inputs point toward AGI.
nando.zh: AI 应像显微镜一样扩展人类能力；把一切输入 token 化的通才智能体，是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步。

nando.en: Learning from video and few-shot prompting realize old 'learning to learn' ideas; innovation can come from anywhere.
nando.zh: 从视频学习与少样本提示让“学会学习”的旧构想成真；创新可以来自任何地方，大模型并非全部。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are now the biggest open challenges, with no solutions yet.
nando.zh: 到 2026 年，他把 AI 安全与负责任部署视为最大且尚未解决的开放难题。

nando.en: Africa is not behind: leapfrogging legacy gaps and local-language models can transform education.
nando.zh: 非洲并不落后：跨越历史遗留差距、用本地语言模型改造教育，是其独特优势。

nando.en: Diversity, inclusion and human skills like communication matter as much as technical progress.
nando.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：多元包容与沟通等人文能力，和技术进步同等重要。

carlpei.en: Startups must survive first, prove themselves with simpler products, and build brand by uniting teams on higher purpose.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年，他强调初创公司要先活下来，用更简单的产品证明自己，并通过统一团队于更高目标来构建品牌。

carlpei.en: AI is the future of phones: agentic, proactive software with generative UI, but most AI is BS and models will commoditize.
carlpei.zh: 2025 年，他转向认为 AI 是手机的未来：智能体式、主动的软件与生成式 UI，但多数 AI 是炒作，模型将商品化。

carlpei.en: Hardware margins are low; Nothing must evolve beyond hardware, using design and marketing arbitrage to differentiate.
carlpei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化认识：硬件利润低，Nothing 必须超越硬件，用设计和营销套利实现差异化。

carlpei.en: Smartphones will shift from app-based to intent-based with agents; only brain-computer interfaces could replace them, not glasses.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年，他明确预测：手机将从基于应用转向基于意图，由智能体执行任务；只有脑机接口能取代手机，而非眼镜。

carlpei.en: Design as core differentiator, brand built on purpose, and solving real user pain points elegantly—not hyping AI.
carlpei.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：设计是核心差异化，品牌基于使命构建，优雅解决真实用户痛点，而非炒作 AI。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; they solve onboarding and boost intelligence, while fine-tuning may become obsolete.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，他认为长上下文窗口被低估，能解决冷启动并大幅提升智能，而微调可能过时。

sholto.en: RL from verifiable rewards is a new scaling axis; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI without new breakthroughs.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他强调基于可验证奖励的强化学习是新的扩展轴，预训练加强化学习或许足以通向 AGI，无需新突破。

sholto.en: Agent reliability, not capability, is the bottleneck; success rate over time horizon is the key metric.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他指出智能体的瓶颈是可靠性而非能力，时间跨度上的成功率是关键指标。

sholto.en: Coding is the leading indicator and most tractable domain; world models are not on the critical path to AGI.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他持续认为编程是领先指标和最易处理的领域，世界模型不在通往 AGI 的关键路径上。

sholto.en: Compute is the new oil; managing fleets of AI agents at higher abstraction will define future work.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，他提出算力是新石油，未来工作将是在更高抽象层管理 AI 智能体集群。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI: grounded experience reduces hallucination and supplies infinite data beyond scarce internet tokens.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他把具身视为通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径：真实经验能减少幻觉，并在互联网高质量 token 枯竭时提供无限数据。

jimfan.en: A consistent thread: simple, elegant end-to-end models scale better than complex modular academic designs; demos are easy, robust products are hard.
jimfan.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年一以贯之的主线：简单优雅的端到端模型比学术界的复杂模块化方案更具可扩展性；做演示容易，做稳健产品极难。

jimfan.en: Reinforcement learning stays a cherry on top: unsupervised learning does most of the work, RL handles low-level control while LLMs plan.
jimfan.zh: 强化学习的定位始终是“锦上添花”：无监督学习承担主要工作，强化学习负责低层控制，LLM 负责高层规划。

jimfan.en: The bottleneck has shifted to data: real-world robot data is scarce and expensive, so synthetic data via simulation and world models is the future.
jimfan.zh: 到 2026 年，瓶颈已转向数据：真实机器人数据稀缺且昂贵，因此通过仿真与世界模型生成合成数据才是未来。

jimfan.en: Deepened bet on embodied scaling: a simple end-to-end robot foundation model, with the physical Turing test as the grand challenge and a GPT-3 moment in about five years.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年对具身 Scaling（规模扩张）的判断深化：押注简单的端到端机器人基础模型，以物理图灵测试为终极挑战，并预计约五年内迎来机器人的 GPT-3 时刻。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks; AI is a creative partner and code is the source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应成为赋能者而非瓶颈；AI 是创意伙伴，代码是事实来源。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable; small teams outperform large squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并用 AI 补缺的通才最有价值；小团队优于大团队。

nadchishtie.en: Hiring shifts to high-slope individuals with intrinsic drive; paid test work and side projects signal more than process docs.
nadchishtie.zh: 招聘转向有内驱力的高斜率个体；付费测试和副业项目比流程文档更能体现信号。

yejin.en: Pre-training gives breadth, but post-training with RLHF and inference-time algorithms matter more; Scaling alone may not yield common sense.
yejin.zh: 预训练提供广度，但后训练中的基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与推理阶段算法更关键；单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）未必能带来常识。

yejin.en: Consistently argues smaller models with better data and algorithms can beat larger ones, a thread from 2023 into 2025.
yejin.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 一以贯之：数据与算法更好的小模型可以胜过更大的模型。

yejin.en: Reframes the bottleneck as data itself; current methods interpolate human knowledge rather than transcend it, so AI must explore the unknown.
yejin.zh: 把瓶颈重新定义为数据本身；当前方法只是对人类知识做插值而非超越，因此 AI 必须探索未知知识。

yejin.en: Deepens on reinforcement learning: RLVR can hurt pass@k, and RL as a pre-training objective rewards information gain for lasting reasoning gains.
yejin.zh: 对强化学习不断深化：RLVR 可能损害 pass@k，而把强化学习作为预训练目标、以信息增益为奖励，能带来持久的推理提升。

yejin.en: Shifts toward pluralistic alignment and diverse synthetic data, rejecting debiasing the internet; frontier models show homogeneity.
yejin.zh: 转向多元对齐与多样化合成数据，否定“净化互联网”的思路；并指出前沿模型存在同质化。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products must feel fast, familiar, and require zero learning.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他主张设计师应写代码以建立共情、加快交付；消费级产品必须快、熟悉、零学习成本。

henrymodisett.en: Don't innovate on interaction design; reuse familiar patterns, and let products grow more powerful without feeling more complex.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他反对在交互设计上创新，主张复用熟悉模式，让产品更强却不显得更复杂。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity at all costs: clear decisions and designer autonomy beat perfection; chase ROI on what to make great.
henrymodisett.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他一以贯之地强调速度为上：清晰决策与设计师自主权胜过完美，只在值得的地方追求极致。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must explain why design helps the company win, and brand narrative becomes a recruiting tool.
henrymodisett.zh: 到 2026 年，他把设计深化为战略武器：创始人须讲清设计为何能帮公司取胜，品牌叙事成为招募工具。

henrymodisett.en: Hire diverse archetypes and self-learning interns, skip structured crits, and trust gut over data in fast-growing startups.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，他主张招募多元类型与自驱的实习生，避开结构化评审，在高速成长的初创公司里凭直觉而非数据决策。

truell.en: Scaling laws still predict progress via more compute and data, but test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling.
truell.zh: 2024 年他仍相信 Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律能带来可预测的进步，但开始押注推理阶段的测试时算力扩张可能超越预训练 Scaling，成为下一阶段的主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration stays central, and natural language won't be the primary way to program.
truell.zh: 2024 年他认为智能体前景可期但尚不实用，人机迭代协作仍是核心；并反共识地判断自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式，示例与直接操作往往更好。

truell.en: Frontier models are poor at bug finding and benchmarks are contaminated proxies; formal verification may become feasible but specifying intent remains hard.
truell.zh: 2024 年他指出前沿模型因缺乏训练数据而难以找 bug、校准也差，基准测试被污染且无法反映真实编码的混乱；形式化验证或可行，但说清意图依旧困难。

truell.en: Programming shifts from code toward higher-level intent specification with humans in the driver's seat; taste and logic design outvalue carefulness.
truell.zh: 到 2025 年他把编程的未来明确为从写代码转向更高层的意图表达，人始终掌握方向盘；品味与逻辑设计能力将比小心谨慎更值钱，这是对 2024 年判断的深化。

truell.en: Every magic moment in Cursor now involves a custom model; the AI shift is bigger than the internet and will take decades.
truell.zh: 2025 年他反共识地承认自研模型成了必需——Cursor 每个惊艳时刻都离不开定制模型；并判断这次 AI 转变比互联网更具颠覆性，且需数十年才能展开。

shazeer.en: LLMs trained on next-token prediction solve an AI-complete problem; Scaling with more compute and data yields smarter AI, though internals remain opaque.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年：基于下一个词预测训练的大语言模型解决了 AI 完全问题；通过更多算力和数据的 Scaling 让 AI 更聪明，但内部机制仍不透明。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling and longer context windows are major near-term opportunities; modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts enable efficient Scaling.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年：推理时算力扩展和更长的上下文窗口是近期重大机遇；混合专家等模块化稀疏架构实现了高效 Scaling。

shazeer.en: Models should learn by acting in the world, not just passively observing; agentic capabilities and reinforcement learning are crucial for AGI.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年：模型应通过在世界中行动来学习，而非被动观察；智能体能力和强化学习对 AGI（通用人工智能）至关重要。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone achieve AGI; open-source models keep pace with frontier models, shrinking the gap.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年：测试时算力扩展推动进步，但单靠它无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能）；开源模型紧跟前沿模型，差距正在缩小。

shazeer.en: AGI is underhyped; its economic impact will far exceed trillion-dollar products, and coding as an AI application enables self-acceleration of AI progress.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年：AGI（通用人工智能）被低估；其经济影响将远超万亿美元级产品，而编码作为 AI 应用能实现 AI 进步的自我加速。

leike.en: AI safety is crucial as capabilities improve; empirical alignment research is under-explored, and the talent gap exceeds funding.
leike.zh: 2018 年：随着能力提升，AI 安全至关重要；实证对齐研究尚待探索，人才缺口大于资金缺口。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman AI; we need scalable oversight, interpretability, and automated alignment research to align next-gen models.
leike.zh: 2023 年：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超级智能；需要可扩展监督、可解释性和自动化对齐研究来对齐下一代模型。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; superalignment team dissolved and compute commitments dishonored; post-training alone can't solve alignment for AGI.
leike.zh: 2024 年：OpenAI 的安全文化被侵蚀；超级对齐团队解散，算力承诺未兑现；仅靠后训练无法解决 AGI（通用人工智能）的对齐问题。

leike.en: Third-party testing and regulatory oversight like SB 1047 are necessary; non-disparagement clauses hinder whistleblowing.
leike.zh: 2024 年：第三方测试和 SB 1047 等监管监督是必要的；禁止贬损条款阻碍举报。

leike.en: Alignment is empirically testable and may be easier than thought since evaluation is easier than generation; worst-case behavior may worsen with capability.
leike.zh: 始终：对齐可实证测试，且可能比想象中容易，因为评估比生成更容易；最坏情况行为可能随能力提升而恶化。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment; self-play and imitation learning provide strong signals; fine-tuning pre-trained models is a major success.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年：机器人需要分层推理来解决长时程信用分配；自对弈与模仿学习提供强信号；微调大型预训练模型是重大成功。

abbeel.en: Unsupervised learning plus reinforcement learning boosts sample efficiency; prior knowledge should augment data, not be hard-coded; pre-trained language models transfer reasoning to non-language tasks.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年：无监督学习结合强化学习大幅提升样本效率；先验知识应用于数据增强而非硬编码；预训练语言模型可将推理模式迁移至非语言任务。

abbeel.en: Consistent focus on sample efficiency and transfer: from fine-tuning pre-trained models to using language models for cross-task generalization.
abbeel.zh: 2018→2021 年：始终关注样本效率与迁移——从微调预训练模型到利用语言模型实现跨任务泛化。

abbeel.en: Reliability (99.9%) is the benchmark for real-world robotics value; a single neural network can generalize across warehouse tasks and end effectors.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年：可靠性（99.9%）是机器人创造真实价值的基准；单一神经网络可泛化至不同仓库任务与末端执行器。
